description: Full GLM 5.3 EXL3 2.75bpw on four Sparks, following drowzeys at ea05ec69 and the creator-published 2026-10-10 image. Uses the Python TensorFold engine and checkpoint MTP drafting, one stream and a 140,000-token window. Each rank receives the same immutable model through the Controller-managed cache. The 100 GiB per-node peak is an estimate covering sharded weights, KV and runtime workspace, not a local measurement. Four physical Sparks and a connected fabric are required; physical execution remains unqualified here.
title: GLM 5.3 full EXL3 TensorFold four Sparks (drowzeys)
